create_QADataset: create a QADataset from a JSON data path with tokenizer and max sequence length settings
create_QAEvalDataset: create a QAEvalDataset from retriever results with a tokenizer and max sequence length
use_MhopSampler: use MhopSampler to batch QA pairs with negative samples per question for training
run_qa_collate: run qa_collate to batch sample dictionaries into padded tensors for model input
use_collate_tokens: use collate_tokens to pad a list of 1D tensors into a uniform 2D tensor
